about_the_game:
This demo contains a short version of the first part of the game located in the laboratory

in this demo you will be acquainted with the story and set the plot for the full game.

You will be able to get used to some of the mechanics of " Code Angel Reloaded " 

such as = 

  • Slash and dismemberment

  • Melee and ranged combat

  • ATM system 

  • VR interactions

The story 

The Year is 3023. Technology has peaked. Humanity is on the brink.

In a world where technological advancement has gone too far, computer viruses have transcended the digital realm. These malevolent entities now take terrifying physical forms, wreaking havoc in the real world. Their origin is shrouded in mystery, but their purpose is clear: destruction.

When all else fails, humanity turns to its last line of defense—the Angel Unit.

You are one of them. A cybernetic operative trained to exterminate these monstrosities with brutal efficiency. Your mission is simple:
ERASE THEM ALL.

FYI :This demo is a work in progress and does not represent the final quality of the product

content_descriptors.notes: A violent game with blood, but without extreme subject or tendencies, a VR FPS that takes inspiration from boomer shooter from the 90's

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: intel i7 series / Ryzen 7 series
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeGorce RTX 3070 / RX 6800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • VR Support: Oculus Quest 2 ( PCVR ) / equivalent or latest
  • Additional Notes: VDXR greatly suggested
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D or Ryzen 7 7700X3D / Intel Core i7 14th/15th gen (or Core Ultra equivalent)
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4080 or AMD RX 7900 XT (16GB+)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • VR Support: Oculus Quest 3 ( PCVR ) / equivalent or latest
  • Additional Notes: VDXR greatly suggested

short_description: A cyberpunk horror VR shooter where computer viruses take physical form. Slash and dismember enemies, navigate neon-lit corridors, and uncover the mystery behind the outbreak. As part of the Angel Unit, humanity's last hope, your mission is clear: ERASE THEM ALL.
